description: Welcome to Your AUTHENTIC Tropical Escape!Forget cookie-cutter rentals. This is your portal to authentic Puerto Rican island life! Just 4 mins from the beach, immerse yourself in vibrant vibes: coqui frogs, roosters, backyard fruit, and lizards. Unwind by our SALTWATER POOL, conquer the game room, or pick fresh fruit. It's an experience for unforgettable memories. Welcome to your true tropical escape!The spaceMore Than Just a Stay, It’s an Adventure in ComfortWelcome to a getaway designed for genuine enjoyment! This isn't just any house; it's a home featuring 3 vibrant, spacious bedrooms, each cooled by its own air conditioning for your ultimate comfort. The master bedroom isn't just bright – it's a serene retreat boasting a massive TV for those perfect cozy nights in, while the living room conveniently includes a sofa bed for extra adventurers.Our fully equipped kitchen isn't just functional; it's your command center for culinary creativity. From the essential coffee maker and toaster to the microwave and kettle, you'll find everything you need to whip up island feasts or simply brew your morning café con leche.For those ready to play, the superhero-themed game room is legendary. Boasting not one, but three arcade machines, a competitive foosball table, and a trove of board games, it’s a hit with everyone – prepare for some serious fun and friendly rivalries!Step outside and truly live the island dream. Relax by the large, inviting SALTWATER pool (because chlorine is so last season!), fire up the grill for an authentic al fresco meal, or explore the backyard for fresh fruit directly from the trees. And whatever you do, don’t miss our stunning, one-of-a-kind mural—it’s the perfect, most social media-worthy backdrop for those unforgettable Puerto Rico memories.Rest easy knowing the property is fully gated and nestled on a peaceful street, guaranteeing serene evenings. Yet, you're still just a breezy 4-minute drive from the beach, vibrant supermarkets, delicious restaurants, and all the island charm you could desire. This home isn't just ideal for a fun and relaxing stay; it’s where your most authentic Puerto Rican adventure truly begins!Nearby Attractions:You are within a 5-minute Drive:Gemela BakeryGuayabos Sea Breeze RestaurantPico de Piedra BeachPlatano Loco RestaurantSupermercado Selectos (Grocery)Within a 10-minute drive:Supermercado Mr. Special (Grocery)Waves Seafood RestaurantMameyito BeachWithin a 15-minute drive:Playa Doña Lala BeachRincón BeachWithin a 30-minute drive:Playa Los AlmendrosThe Famous Crash Boat BeachWithin a 40-minute drive:Playa Jobos, IsabelaGuest accessGuests have access to the entire house, including all indoor and outdoor spaces, ensuring a private and comfortable stay. Outdoors, the saltwater pool, grill, fruit trees, and beautiful mural are all yours to explore.Please note that the storage room within the main house and the lower portion of the property are locked and reserved for owner use. description: You'll find this to be one of the most-secure, best-located properties in town, especially if you want to experience Rincon without having to rent a car. My apartment is walking distance to the town square, 150 yards to a secluded sandy beach, and right across the street from a supermarket, fruit vendors and food carts. The building has backup water cisterns and a 250KW standby diesel generator that will power the entire complex. Relax in comfort!The spaceWhen we bought this place, it was a new, empty vanilla box, left over from the crash in 2008- and what a great canvas! We got busy painting and furniture shopping.We wanted to create something that was not only comfortable but completely turn-key for people coming to visit Rincon. I think that most people don't vacation to sit inside, they visit a place to experience the people and the activities of the place itself. Especially in Rincón, known worldwide for the surfing, the diving, the beaches and the sun. That said, everyone appreciates a clean, quiet, well-appointed spot to return to at the end of the day.And that is what Sea Beach 303 is.303 is equipped with quiet, efficient inverter air conditioning. There are two bedrooms, two full baths, a washer and dryer, a hairdryer and iron. Beach towels are available- look in the closets. Both bedrooms have queen size memory foam beds.The kitchen has everything you need to cook a great meal. When I travel, I love a place with a garlic press and a good set of knives, a toaster and a blender, tongs and a side-cut can opener, pots and pans, quality silverware and some kitchen shears. And of course there’s a coffeemaker and I stock my favorite Puerto Rican coffee for you to try. It's the best!There are comfortable couches for you to relax upon, and a large dining table with a great view when your food is ready.In the tropics, hydration is really important- particularly when you're running around in the sun all day. So in the kitchen we installed a reverse osmosis filtration system that creates all the delicious water you'll need. The refrigerator water dispenser is fed from the same RO system.There is a sparkling pool for your use, and to reach the beach is just a short walk along a flower-lined path. Enjoy!Guest accessYou'll have access to the entire condo, of course. This property is fully self-contained and secure, with two bedrooms, two full baths and a well-appointed kitchen. There is a private balcony overlooking the pool with views to the ocean just 150 yards away- and the sunsets are incomparable. Guests are welcome to use the pool and cabana.Other things to noteI have electronic locks so you need not carry a key and I can accommodate any check-in time after 3 pm. :)
